mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pets (publisher_id, owner_id, current_custodian_id, source_type, ownership_status, authorization_status, species, breed, age, gender, sterilized, vaccinated, health_desc, status, location, geo_hash, city, district) VALUES (#{publisherId}, #{ownerId}, #{currentCustodianId}, #{sourceType}, #{ownershipStatus}, #{authorizationStatus}, #{species}, #{breed}, #{age}, #{gender}, #{sterilized}, #{vaccinated}, #{healthDesc}, #{status}, CASE WHEN #{lng,jdbcType=DOUBLE} IS NULL OR #{lat,jdbcType=DOUBLE} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lng,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{lat,jdbcType=DOUBLE}), 4326) END, CASE WHEN #{lng,jdbcType=DOUBLE} IS NULL OR #{lat,jdbcType=DOUBLE} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ST_GeoHash(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lng,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{lat,jdbcType=DOUBLE}), 4326), 6) END, #{city}, #{district})
mapper.select: SELECT id, publisher_id, owner_id, current_custodian_id, source_type, ownership_status, authorization_status, species, breed, age, gender, sterilized, vaccinated, health_desc, status, geo_hash, city, district FROM pets WHERE id = #{id} AND status != 'DELETED'

SELECT id, publisher_id, owner_id, current_custodian_id, source_type, ownership_status, authorization_status, species, breed, age, gender, sterilized, vaccinated, health_desc, status, geo_hash, city, district FROM pets WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
